name: Jamtska
confidence_why: Westin 1897, Flemström 1973 and Reinhammar 2005 describe only the tonal word-accent contrast (acute, grave and a two-peaked circumflex on apocopated words) and none of them states where word stress falls, while Österberg 1914, the only phonology of a Jamtland dialect, has not been read.

audit.recode_to: If Österberg 1914 (or another primary) states it: fixed root-/first-syllable main stress of the Swedish type (quantity-insensitive, lexical accent 1/2 + central-Jämtland two-peaked circumflex as tonal overlay; East-Jämtland compound-final stress kept as a sub-dialectal morphology note). Do not reclassify by presumption before a primary statement is in hand.
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: every deciding segment is verbatim where the record says it is -- Westin 1897 p.18 and p.9 on the page scan we hold and text, Flemström p.2 in the born-digital text we hold; the record's own caveat about transliterated phonetic forms is accurate. A a full-text search for stress/accent Westin (89 pp) confirms there is no simplex stress-placement statement elsewhere in it. (2) Deciding source: an 1897 landsmålsalfabet key plus a 2-page 1973 popular sketch plus Wikipedia -- primary and correctly read, but not a grammar or phonology. Glottolog's descriptive list (Glottolog's most extensive descriptions: Österberg 1914 phonology 129 pp; Reinhammar 2005 grammar sketch 109 pp; Forsåker 1999 dictionary) shows two fuller descriptions; I downloaded Reinhammar 2005 (KGAA open access) and read its accent passages (pp.15-16, 70-71): it too gives no simplex placement rule, but frames the accent system as identical in type to standard Swed

sources.quote: p.15: 'Som bekant kan olika ord ha olika »betoning», accent. Liksom rspr har hdm dels s.k. akut accent, dels s.k. grav accent. ... vi kan ta ha'nnel 'handel' : ha`nnel 'handla' för resp. akut och grav accent. ... Vi har därtill i hdm en vanligt förekommande accenttyp ... den »kluvna» vokalen i många ord (kaast, seet osv.). Det är egentligen ett slags grav accent. Den betecknas i landsmålsalfabetet med ett »tak» (cirkumflex) över vokalen'; p.16: 'Hdm har i sammansättningar i många fall annan betoning än rspr.
